authority: Explicit project owner reply in current FIX2 CHIEF task

context_integration.preserved: Current unpublished FIX2 work backed up before application. Current source-store prefix/type-safe comparison retained.
context_integration.additional_scope_control: Default-off canonical_fragments; enabled only at existing Ledger cold-scan decoder construction

prohibited_changes: Persisted receipt formats or original write codecs
Existing Ledger history rewrite or migration
Acceptance or publication solely because the patch applies
acceptance_gates: Byte-for-byte identical canonical serialized values on retained measured-load history
Exactly identical derived content and receipt digests
Identical full historical replay semantic state and integrity verdicts
Cold reopen/startup fails closed on tampered or inconsistent history
Startup/resource improvement sufficient to meet unchanged qualification limits
Directly affected Ledger/Authority/reconstruction tests and composed affected regression pass
Independent review has no substantive integrity or persistence findings
discrepancy_rule: If any byte, digest, reconstructed state, receipt identity or integrity result differs: stop, remove only this patch's changes, preserve current unrelated FIX2 and failure evidence.
measured_history_provenance: Retained original-API Ledger benchmark with actual source shape and original Authority denials. Not an actual-public admission campaign.
publication_authorized_only_after: All normal frozen-delta, actual qualification, preflight and successor-start gates close
